promotionChecklist: Run pnpm ship:ready for release-bound runtime proof.
Run pnpm ship:candidate; this invalidates older platform evidence.
Browser-smoke Ship Readiness, Cockpit, Dashboard, and Brain Map.
Validate macOS, Windows, and Linux install paths before broad sharing.
Run pnpm ship:promote:ready -- --runtime-root <installed-root> --gateway-url <candidate-url> --confirm-browser-smoke as the final share gate.
knownIssues: Installer validation is still pending on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

blockers: Archive hashes and platform promotion evidence are maintained by the package sender, outside this immutable installed kit.
